high_level_description: A cinematic 35mm film still of a lone wooden sailboat on a glassy lake at dusk, the boat placed on a right-third vertical with the horizon at the lower third, in a cool muted blue palette.

style_description.lighting: Cool overcast dusk light with a small warm sun low at the horizon; muted and low-contrast, no harsh specular highlights.
style_description.photo: 35mm motion-picture film still, 16:9 framing, subtle grain, slightly desaturated, anamorphic-style horizontal flare on the sun

compositional_deconstruction.background: Windless evening on a wide lake. Horizon sits at the lower third. A dusty blue-violet sky with a small amber sun low at the horizon and a thin gold streak reflected across the glassy teal water. Subtle 35mm grain throughout, no halation.

elements.desc: Lone wooden sailboat on the right-third vertical in the midground, dark varnished hull and a single tall mast with a slack white sail hanging limp in the still air. No visible crew.
Mirror-perfect reflection of the sailboat and its mast doubling straight down into the glassy teal water directly beneath the hull, inverted and slightly darker than the boat itself.
Out-of-focus reed tips slicing into the lower-left foreground, soft dark blades against the teal water, blurred from proximity to the camera lens.
